name: manual_c3d436
claim: When an external or uploaded design document proposes new infrastructure (a new standalone package, a new service, a new independent module), read the target codebase's own existing ownership/authority documentation FIRST -- specifically any module that already claims responsibility for the exact decision space the new design touches -- before implementing the design as written. An external plan cannot know about invariants it never saw. Implementing it verbatim risks creating a second, competing source of authority for a decision the codebase already assigns to one place, even when the new code is otherwise well-designed.

decisions.notes: Directly prevented a second, competing gateway-authority path from being created.

rationale: Directly prevented a second, competing gateway-authority path from being created.
